title: The Base Cherngtalay
shortDescription: The Base Cherngtalay is a low-rise condominium by Sansiri in Cherng Talay, Phuket, on a site of about 4 rai.
description: The Base Cherngtalay is a low-rise condominium by Sansiri in Cherng Talay, Phuket, on a site of about 4 rai. It comprises two 8-storey buildings with 341 one- and two-bedroom apartments of roughly 27 to 63 sqm. Units are sold furnished, and the project offers a pool, fitness center, co-working lounge, co-kitchen, organic farm and onsen.
